lastCompletedStory.title: Wire the deterministic bump step into cam ship before push

nextStoryContext: US-003 added runShipBump() in src/release/ship-bump.ts (injectable SpawnFn+ClockFn pattern, modeled on finalizeCycleClose). The function is wired into dispatchShip via the --bump flag. parseShipArgs now returns { help, finalize, bump }. _buildBumpOpts(cwd) is the production factory in index.ts. cam-ship.md (both mirrors) now has 9 steps: Step 4 is 'cam ship --bump', Step 5 is finalize, Step 6 is push. All 1464 tests pass. If a future story needs to extend the ship-bump step (e.g. add git push, or integrate with finalize), import from src/release/ship-bump.ts and extend ShipBumpOptions.

officialDocsValidated.summary: src/release/ship-bump.ts imports only internal modules (bump.ts, version.ts) and node:child_process types. No external npm library was touched; no fetch needed.
